title: nauclea griffithii
intro: Nauclea griffithii, commonly known as Quinine Tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Thailand, Myanmar, and Cambodia. The health benefits of Nauclea griffithii include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, malaria, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Nauclea griffithii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
